channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Who is Iranian oil tycoon Shamkhani whose ship is stranded in Hormuz?
item.description: Iranian oil shipping magnate Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani has been sanctioned by the West over his shadow fleet.

item.title: Explosion in Damascus cafe causes casualties
item.description: An explosion inside a cafe in Damascus’s Hejaz district has caused casualties, according to Syrian state media.

item.title: At least five killed in explosion inside central Damascus cafe
item.description: Blast at a cafe reportedly kills five people and injures many more.

item.title: An extra 229,000 deaths: Is that the cost of US-UK drugs deal?
item.description: Research finds that trade deal requiring UK to buy more medicines from US takes away money from other parts of NHS.

item.title: Eight Thai monks killed after child drives truck into procession
item.description: Police say 11-year-old boy who took his parents' vehicle without permission is now in custody and will be questioned.

item.title: Canadian boy, 11, dies of rabies after waking to bat on his face
item.description: Rabies infections are rare in Canada. There have been 28 human deaths due to rabies in the country since 1924.

item.title: South Africa and Ghana in diplomatic row over alleged killing of migrant
item.description: South Africa denies claims that a Ghanaian citizen was killed in anti-migrant protests in Cape Town.

item.title: Residents of Ethiopian town forced to kill hundreds of their own dogs after rabies deaths
item.description: Some residents reluctantly hung their dogs to avoid being arrested or fined, locals tell the BBC.

item.title: Nine Thai monks killed after 11-year-old driver collides with procession
item.description: The group of 35 monks and five lay followers were walking by the roadside when the truck ploughed into them.
